matdol — VESA DSC (.dsc) plugin
================================

matdol opens VESA DSC bitstream files (.dsc) only when the separate, optional
decoder plugin (Matdol.Dsc.dll) is installed. The plugin is an open-source
project that is distributed as source code only — no prebuilt binaries are
provided, so you build it yourself:

    https://github.com/tjaykim/matdol-dsc

Install
  1. Install the .NET 8 SDK (8.0.100 or later):
     https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0
  2. Get the source (git clone, or "Code > Download ZIP" on GitHub) and build
     the library in the repository folder:

         dotnet build src/Matdol.Dsc -c Release

     Result: src/Matdol.Dsc/bin/Release/net8.0/Matdol.Dsc.dll
     (The same Matdol.Dsc.dll works on Windows, Linux and macOS. See the
     repository's README, "Building", for details.)
  3. Copy Matdol.Dsc.dll into your matdol plugin folder (no admin rights
     needed; create the folder if it does not exist):
         Windows : %APPDATA%\matdol\plugins
         Linux   : ~/.config/matdol/plugins
         macOS   : ~/.config/matdol/plugins
     (Copying it next to the matdol executable, or into a "plugins" folder
     there, also works.)
  4. Restart matdol. Help (F1) shows "VESA DSC (.dsc) plugin: installed".

Without the plugin, .dsc files open as headerless raw binary data.

Note: VESA DSC is a standard covered by patents of VESA member companies.
The plugin is kept separate, as source code only, so that you decide
whether to build and use it.
